name: Markov
short: Per-user Markov text models, chain stats, and admin user controls
description: ZanCogs-compatible Markov with chain statistics, opt-out-respecting server admin enrollment and data deletion.
end_user_data_statement: Stores user message-derived Markov models (across guilds), opt-in/opt-out flags, user model settings, and per-server admin-enabled user IDs. Guild administrator enrollment is announced and optionally DM-notified. Users can opt out with markov disable and delete models with markov reset. The cog supports Red's user data deletion.
